create_multicontrolnet: create a MultiControlNetModel by passing a list of ControlNetModel instances to the constructor
run_multicontrolnet_forward: run the forward pass on multiple ControlNets and merge their down block and mid block outputs
save_multicontrolnet_pretrained: save all wrapped ControlNet models to disk with indexed directory suffixes using save_pretrained
load_multicontrolnet_from_pretrained: load multiple pretrained ControlNet models from disk into a MultiControlNetModel using from_pretrained
review_multicontrolnet_nets: review the ModuleList of wrapped ControlNetModel instances stored in the nets attribute
